entities.summary: Aegna is an Estonian island in the Bay of Tallinn in the Baltic Sea. Administratively it is part of the city of Tallinn, the capital of Estonia and is a sub district of the Kesklinn district. Aegna is a island. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
